title: Create RecipeCatalog core model and loader
description: Add the new observable `RecipeCatalog` and its entry/grouping model in `CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeCatalog.swift`. Implement recursive `.cook` enumeration, eager parsing, thumbnail lookup reuse, parse-failure logging through `Loggers.recipes`, off-main-thread load execution, and main-actor state publication while preserving previous results during reload.
acceptance_criteria: `RecipeCatalog` is an `@Observable` type with enough public surface to expose loaded state, loading state, grouped recipes, reload entry points, and access to parsed recipes already in memory.
Catalog loading walks the configured recipes folder recursively with the same effective recipe scope as the current discovery flow and parses every discovered `.cook` file.
Malformed recipes are omitted from catalog results and log an error through `Loggers.recipes` with public file path and private error text.
Reload does not clear existing results before replacement, and state updates occur on the main actor after background work completes.

handoff_summary.completed: RecipeCatalog.swift created with: RecipeEntry (Identifiable, URL-equality Equatable, displayName computed), CatalogSection grouping type, and RecipeCatalog (@Observable @MainActor) exposing sections/isLoaded/isLoading state, load(from:)/reload() entry points, entry(for:) lookup, and private static scan/cookEntries/parseEntry/findThumbnail helpers mirroring RecipeDiscovery patterns.
handoff_summary.remaining: Downstream beads must: (1) remove/replace RecipeDiscovery.swift and RecipeFile.swift, (2) update RecipesListView to read from catalog via @Environment and add .refreshable, (3) update RecipeDetailSheet to take RecipeEntry instead of RecipeFile, (4) wire RecipeCatalog into AppRoot.swift alongside AisleCatalog, (5) write RecipeCatalogTests.swift.
handoff_summary.risks: 1. Recipe type Equatable conformance — RecipeEntry implements == by URL only, which is correct for identity but downstream beads should not assume value equality. 2. Static methods on @MainActor class are nonisolated and safe to call from Task.detached under Swift 5; Swift 6 strict concurrency may flag RecipeCatalog.noFolderSectionName access from scan — it is a static let (safe), but may need nonisolated annotation. 3. RecipeDiscovery.noFolderSectionName still exists; RecipeCatalog.noFolderSectionName is independent — the bead removing RecipeDiscovery should not delete the RecipeCatalog copy.
handoff_summary.next_action: Wire RecipeCatalog into AppRoot, update RecipesListView and RecipeDetailSheet to consume it, then remove RecipeDiscovery and RecipeFile.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: RecipeDiscovery.swift and RecipeFile.swift are still present and referenced by existing views. Beads that update RecipesListView, RecipeDetailSheet, and AppRoot must coordinate to avoid a window where the catalog exists but views still use the old scan pattern.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: 1. @MainActor on the class (not just methods) ensures all @Observable property mutations are actor-isolated without explicit MainActor.run blocks. 2. RecipeEntry.== compares by URL only — Recipe is not assumed Equatable. 3. noFolderSectionName is defined locally in RecipeCatalog (not borrowed from RecipeDiscovery) so the catalog is self-contained after RecipeDiscovery is removed. 4. Concurrent reload calls are allowed to race to completion (last writer wins) — coalescing deferred to a follow-up if contention becomes a problem.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written in this bead (tester agent responsibility). RecipeCatalogTests.swift is expected to cover: empty folder, mixed valid/invalid recipes, multi-subfolder grouping, and reload after disk changes.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Catalog is rebuilt from scratch on every load/reload — no incremental update. Memory bound is unbounded (acceptable for expected recipe folder sizes per spec). No Swift 6 sendability annotations added; may require nonisolated or Sendable adjustments when the project adopts strict concurrency.

conflict_risks: RecipeDiscovery.swift and RecipeFile.swift are still present and referenced by existing views. Beads that update RecipesListView, RecipeDetailSheet, and AppRoot must coordinate to avoid a window where the catalog exists but views still use the old scan pattern.

execution_history.summary: Created CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeCatalog.swift with the @Observable @MainActor RecipeCatalog type and its supporting RecipeEntry and CatalogSection models. The catalog replicates RecipeDiscovery.scan's folder-walking logic (1-level subfolder scope), adds eager CooklangParser parsing per file, logs parse failures through Loggers.recipes with correct privacy annotations, updates state atomically on the main actor after off-thread work, and preserves previous results during reload.
